audience: Local adults near each branch who want to train at quieter hours and compare gyms on price and convenience.

copy_lines.text: Tren nar det passer deg. Ekte medlemmer, ekte timer.

hypothesis: A hybrid creative set can hit the 150-membership goal within budget, because the all-human route needs 33 extra memberships to break even, 22 percent of the goal, that off-peak sign-ups are unlikely to add.
insight: Off-peak slots sell on belonging and routine, not hype; seeing real members at real classes converts better than a polished promo.

maker_recommendation.rationale: Decide puts break-even at 33 of the 150 goal memberships, 22 percent of the goal, a low bar; a hybrid cut uses AI for volume and variants and a real shoot for the hero, balancing the 700 kr value per membership against production cost.

mandatories.text: An AI image or AI actor that presents a synthetic person as a real member can be misleading marketing (markedsforingsloven par. 7); AI presenters must not pose as real testimonials.
If the campaign also reaches EU audiences, realistic AI-made people, places or products that could pass as real must be visibly labelled as AI (EU AI Act Article 50).
AI-generated creative is disclosed to the client and labelled to the audience where a reasonable viewer could take an AI presenter for a real member.

objective: Fill Fjellbre's off-peak class slots across every branch and convert 150 new memberships in the campaign window.
open_questions: What is each branch's real off-peak conversion rate and CPM, which would replace the assumed 700 kr value per membership?
Could an AI presenter read as a real member and raise a misleading-marketing risk?
